note: the standard count of set classes of cardinality 2..10 under Tn/TnI; cardinalities 0,1,11,12 are trivial and excluded

Forte (1973) packs from the left; Rahn (1980) packs from the right. The literature count of affected prime forms is 6 of 208. If this run does not reproduce 6, the divergence is reported UNVERIFIED and the spec must name its convention explicitly rather than assume one.

THE LOAD-BEARING CAVEAT for the user's (c): the interval vector does NOT determine the set class. Z-related pairs share an interval vector and are genuinely different objects. So 'a classification that can say all the other notes it is NOT' is a real and computable object, but it is NOT a complete invariant — it is a lossy one, and the loss is exactly the Z-relation.

note: §3.46.3: +4 (fifth) ⟷ +3 (fourth) under read-reversal; 4+3=7

in ℤ/12 the tritone (6) is the UNIQUE self-inverse interval — 12 is even so the octave CAN be bisected. In ℤ/7 no step is self-inverse because 7 is odd (§3.46.2's 7/2 = 3.5). That is precisely why the loop-edge defect of (a) is invisible in the ℤ/7 lane and lands on 6 in the ℤ/12 lane.
